checks.evidence: Revocation of emergency message acknowledgement, step 2: OBU sends an acknowledgement for the revocation that requests one.

invented: Acknowledgement refers to the timestamp of the revocation message (TS-123), which the requirement does not state.
OBU does not acknowledge a revocation of an unknown emergency message because it is inconsistent (SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.1). This is written as an assumption but goes beyond the requirement.
